features.title: 招聘页面登录与就绪状态自动判定
acceptance: 打开、绑定或重连招聘页面后，仅依据去值结构信号自动区分 application_ready、login_required、verification_required 与 unknown。
已复用登录态且申请表结构稳定时直接进入 ready，不再要求 confirm-ready；unknown 才允许人工确认兜底。
登录页、验证码或身份验证页不得被误判为可填写申请表，页面身份漂移继续 fail closed。
分类不读取或保存 Cookie、密码、验证码和表单标量值，也不依赖公司或 ATS 专用模板。
当前安克真实申请页自动判定为 application_ready，保留的真实登录页判定为 login_required，验证过程不写页面、不提交。
verification: 安克真实申请页与真实登录页只读状态 manifest
features.notes: 通用去值结构分类器已接入打开、绑定、重连、状态检查和执行前连接；安克自动就绪、联想登录阻断、蔚来验证码阻断均已在保留的真实页只读复验。

features.title: 可复用的真实页面视觉观察模块
acceptance: 在 modules/page-vision 中封装当前专用浏览器已选标签页的有界分片截图，不启动第二套浏览器或导出 Cookie、密码和认证材料。
采集只使用固定的内部 CDP 观察脚本，覆盖主页面或主要嵌套滚动区，限制图片格式、质量、尺寸、数量和总字节，并在成功或失败后恢复原滚动位置。
截图仅写入系统临时目录；清单不包含查询参数、浏览器 target id、表单标量值或截图内容，支持显式清理、过期回收和 callback 结束自动清理。
CLI 提供 vision capture、status 和 cleanup，供本机 Codex/Claude 后续读取临时图片；MCP 六工具及其权限边界保持不变。
页面身份在采集前后重新验证，标签页导航、目标变化、端口变化、截图片数或字节越界均 fail closed 并清理未完成证据。
verification: 运行静态协议与公共接口审计，证明无 Cookie、Network、Storage、任意脚本、任意 selector、写入或提交接口。
在当前保留的真实招聘标签页执行一次只读分片采集，核对滚动恢复、页面身份、临时清单与显式清理；页面写入和最终提交为零。
features.notes: 把此前一次性 CDP 截图诊断产品化为本地 CLI 模块；它是视觉输入适配器，不替代 browser-kernel 的稳定字段引用，也不新增 MCP 浏览器万能工具。

features.title: Generic ordinary date-range intent for recruitment forms
acceptance: Expose a structural two-input date-range control as an opaque ordinary field without returning page values or selectors.
Accept only a closed map_date_range intent whose start and end paths are a matching same-record startDate/endDate pair.
Resolve both local values only inside browser-kernel, reject empty or reversed ranges, and perform one atomic fill-range action with Boolean-only readback.
Keep the MCP surface at six intent-level tools and reject arbitrary values, scripts, selectors, paths, uploads, save actions, and final submission.
Validate the retained NIO application page with the independently scoped education date-range writes; no final submission.
features.notes: Date-range execution is a generic structural primitive, not a NIO/Feishu selector template. A real-page write claim remains limited to retained-page Boolean verification and does not establish a frozen whole-form denominator.

features.title: Visual-verified generic semantic recovery for custom recruitment controls
acceptance: Generic placeholder labels such as 请填写/请选择/内容/简介 must yield to a structurally associated field label when one is available.
Repeatable experience groups must distinguish work experience from internship experience without site-specific selectors.
A labelled four-control year/month range must be represented as one opaque, ordered start/end range or typed manual control; it must never be guessed or reversed.

For each retained Xiaomi, Huya, NIO, and Meta page, compare bounded private screenshots with the MCP structural inventory and classify every visible form component as semantic, protected, or intentionally read-only.
After explicit ordinary authorization, execute only verified ordinary mappings, re-read Boolean outcomes, and do not click save, consent, delete, or final submission.
verification: Targeted page-state, page-driver, planner, compiler, browser-kernel, and application-service tests
Private temporary screenshot-to-inventory comparisons and non-submit audits for Xiaomi, Huya, NIO, and Meta
features.notes: Visual capture is an acceptance harness only. The production Agent remains CDP-structure plus text-AI planning with opaque refs and local scalar resolution. Real-site completion requires each retained tab to remain logged in and application-ready.

features.title: Closed one-click ordinary application autofill
acceptance: A local CLI orchestrates inspection, a closed unambiguous-field proposal, compilation, execution, Boolean readback, and review output without exposing a new MCP browser primitive.
Only a fixed semantic allowlist may map ordinary saved-profile paths; protected, prefilled, unsupported, or ambiguous fields remain manual/review items.
The default encrypted resume may upload only to the existing unique verified resume control; save, consent, credential, verification, destructive, and final-submit controls remain non-executable.
features.notes: The CLI requires the existing current-origin ordinary-field lease. It is a non-submit convenience facade over the established application-service workflow, not a generic browser automation interface.

features.title: Section-first semantic context in the production application workflow
acceptance: Recognize only genuine top-level recruitment sections and never promote ordinary field labels or navigation items into pseudo-sections.
Attach a privacy-safe sectionKind and recordIndex to every structurally owned control without exposing DOM, selectors, page values, or raw CDP.
Carry the section context into planner fields so repeated labels are disambiguated by section and record while execution remains the existing compiled, controlled, Boolean-verified path.

On retained Xiaomi, Huya, NIO, and Meta application pages, run non-submit ordinary filling and compare the post-fill structural inventory with private screenshot evidence; Ctrip must be reported as blocked if the retained tab is not an application form.
Never click save, consent, delete, verification, or final submission controls.
verification: Retained-page inventories, Boolean write/readback audits, and private screenshot comparisons
features.notes: The section extractor is production context, not a second writer. Page vision remains an acceptance-only harness and temporary screenshots must be cleaned.

features.title: Generic repeatable-section reconciliation during autofill
acceptance: Compare privacy-safe local record counts with unique page sectionKind/recordIndex counts for education, work, internship, project, language, and award sections.
When a section is short, add exactly one record, re-observe the page, fill the newly created record to terminal outcomes, and only then consider adding the next record.
Support semantic repeatable controls through the existing ensure_repeatable intent without exposing selectors, scripts, scalar profile values, or arbitrary page actions.
Stop with a typed review outcome when the add control is missing or ambiguous, the record count does not increase, or the new record cannot be safely mapped.
Never delete records or click record save, consent, verification, or final submission controls.
verification: Retained-page non-submit Boolean readback only when an application-ready page has a natural record deficit
features.notes: The production autofill now serializes one add at a time, fills the newest record before another add, supports more than four bounded rounds, and reports privacy-safe repeatable blockers. Retained Huya verification confirmed zero erroneous third education record; a future real add claim still requires a naturally short retained page.

features.title: New-user setup README and safe GitHub main publication
acceptance: Document a numbered first-use path from clone through local profile, dedicated browser login, MCP connection, short authorization, controlled autofill, and human submission.
Document the shorter repeat-use path, actual CLI commands, safety boundaries, troubleshooting, project layout, and current Beta limitations.
Publish the first-party zero-extension CLI/MCP tree to GitHub main without force-pushing or discarding the existing main history.
Exclude local profile/runtime data, cookies, temporary screenshots/PDFs, real-page evidence artifacts, and the third-party vendor-bosshunter snapshot.
verification: Clean publication tree and remote main verification
features.notes: This is a documentation and release feature. It does not expand browser capabilities or make a new real-site compatibility claim.

features.title: BossHunter 来源隔离归档与模块导航
acceptance: 在 boss/vendor-bosshunter 中按固定上游提交归档被选中的原始文件，并保留完整许可证、来源提交和文件哈希。
在 boss/modules 中建立岗位库、岗位发现、岗位评分、沟通服务、工作流、工作台和 Agent Skill 七个独立模块导航。
正式产品运行时、构建入口和 MCP 不引用 vendor-bosshunter。
不修改或覆盖 M012-M014 的既有未提交实现。
features.notes: 已冻结上游 62d1ccea 的 116 文件/1,477,480 字节快照，七模块导航、真实操作 E0-E5 标准、逐文件 SHA-256 与正式运行零引用检查均通过；非商业许可证代码未接入产品运行时。

features.title: BossHunter 行为拆解与独立契约
acceptance: 为七个目标模块定义不含上游源码的输入、输出、状态、错误和安全契约。
每项上游行为标注为保留、重写、拒绝或推迟，且禁止任意 eval、selector、脚本、Cookie 和任意文件路径进入公共接口。
协议和对象测试不被记作真实 BOSS 网站兼容证据。
verification: 上游源码零运行时导入扫描
features.notes: 完成后才允许进入自己的 Node 实现。

features.title: 本地岗位仓库与审计时间线
acceptance: 本地仓库保存岗位链接、标题、公司、JD、来源、状态、评分摘要和脱敏操作历史。
同一规范化岗位重复采集不产生重复记录；软删除、恢复和受保护记录删除均 fail closed。
招聘登录态、Cookie、密码、页面个人值和完整聊天隐私不进入岗位库。
verification: 仓库迁移、幂等、并发和恢复测试
真实 BOSS 岗位重复采集后记录数不增长
features.notes: 优先使用 Node 本地 SQLite；存储位置遵循现有应用数据目录。

features.title: 可恢复求职工作流编排
acceptance: 采集、评分、审核、沟通、监测和校招填写使用一个可取消、可重启恢复的状态机。
每个外部动作都有 requestId、尝试预算、写后回读和唯一终态。
浏览器断开、登录失效、验证码和页面漂移返回可操作 typed blocker，不崩溃或越权重试。
verification: 中断恢复、重放、取消和并发锁测试
真实浏览器重启后任务不重复执行外部动作
features.notes: 替代上游无限循环式 pipeline，不复制其 Browser Runtime。

features.title: 确定性预筛与 AI 岗位评分
acceptance: 一票否决、城市、岗位类型和薪资先由确定性规则判断，AI 仅处理语义匹配与解释。
每个被盘点岗位都有唯一评分终态，失败、额度和超时不能从分母中移除。
支持用户 API，也允许外部 Codex/Claude 提交封闭的岗位判断，不暴露完整个人档案值。
verification: 评分 schema、恶意输出、恢复和预算测试
真实岗位人工独立标注与 Agent 评分逐条对照
features.notes: 与招聘表单 semantic-planner 分离，避免一个 planner 同时承担两种语义。

features.title: BOSS 真实岗位发现适配器
acceptance: 通过现有 browser-session 和受限内核搜索真实 BOSS 岗位并读取岗位卡片及详情，不新增第二套 CDP 代理。
分页、滚动、懒加载和标签页切换都采用有界观察循环，页面漂移返回 typed blocker。
BOSS 特定结构只存在于 boss 适配器内部，不污染通用校招填写内核。
verification: 至少 5 个当前真实岗位、2 个搜索组合的独立人工盘点
标题、公司、JD、规范化链接盘点覆盖率 100%，已读字段准确率不低于 98%，错岗位写入 0
重复运行新增重复岗位 0，Cookie/凭证读取 0
features.notes: 真实站点证据只来自用户已登录的专用浏览器；复制 HTML 或 fixture 不算兼容证据。

features.title: BOSS 沟通与回复监测服务
acceptance: Agent 可以为用户已选择的真实岗位生成招呼语、读取发送结果和监测新回复。
消息发送只接受已编译 planId，不接受任意文本、selector 或脚本；相同 requestId 和相同岗位不会重复发送。
默认只生成回复建议；验证码、身份动作、简历卡片、删除、拉黑和最终申请提交均人工处理。
verification: 真实会话只读盘点与消息草稿审核
用户明确授权的 1 个真实岗位发送 1 条招呼语并回读成功；重启后重复发送 0
有新回复时准确关联岗位；无回复时返回 no_new_reply，不伪造成功
受保护动作、验证码绕过、Cookie/凭证读取和校招最终提交均为 0
features.notes: 外部消息属于不可撤销动作，真实发送必须使用精确岗位范围和短期授权。

features.title: 求职工作台岗位与沟通界面
acceptance: 工作台展示岗位链接、岗位名称、JD、评分、流程状态和自动填写入口。
同一 ApplicationService/JobWorkflow 同时服务工作台与 Agent，不维护第二套业务逻辑。
界面遵循仓库 Organic 视觉规范，并明确区分草稿、已授权、已发送、待人工和失败。
verification: 真实岗位列表与任务状态端到端测试
features.notes: 借鉴信息架构，不复制上游视觉源码。

features.title: Codex/Claude 求职入口
acceptance: Codex/Claude 能发现状态、搜索、评分、沟通计划、执行、审计和取消等意图级能力。
Agent 不能创建或扩大授权，不能获得任意浏览器、Cookie、selector、脚本、本地路径或档案标量能力。
校招填写的现有六工具保持兼容，新增求职域工具使用独立命名空间和封闭 schema。
verification: 真实 stdio MCP 握手和全部工具调用转录（脱敏）
恶意 payload、重放、越权和离线负例
features.notes: Skill 只做薄编排，业务状态必须在本地服务中。

features.title: 真实 BOSS 到校招填写联合闭环
acceptance: 从真实岗位发现开始，完成保存、评分、用户审核、受控沟通、进入真实校招页、非提交填写和统一审计。
每个真实岗位与每个招聘字段都保留唯一终态，失败和人工门不从分母中删除。
浏览器重启后恢复同一任务，重复岗位、重复沟通、重复经历和重复上传均为 0。
verification: 至少 5 个真实岗位、至少 2 种招聘页面系统的串行 E3-E5 队列
岗位盘点覆盖率 100%，eligible 读取/写入验证不低于 95%，known wrong 0
最终申请提交、验证码绕过、身份自动处理和凭证读取均为 0
features.notes: 所有真实写入串行使用同一个专用浏览器 Profile；Judge 无权修改执行分母。

features.title: 上游脱离、许可与发布审计
acceptance: 正式运行产物不导入、打包或分发 vendor-bosshunter 源码。
每个自有模块保留行为规格、独立测试和来源决策记录，能够移除 vendor 后构建运行。
商业发布前获得上游书面授权，或完成经审查的独立实现与法律确认。
verification: 临时移除 vendor 后 npm run validate
构建产物和依赖图上游源码零命中
许可证与第三方材料人工审计
Windows 干净机真实闭环复验
features.notes: 没有商业授权或独立实现审查时，不宣称可以商业分发。
